scope: 13 local immersion rule inventories; no course-description review or whole-degree completion

routes.title: Advertising and Public Relations Immersion
routes.rule_summary: One advertising/public-relations foundation and two electives; nine hours. The repeated foundation codes in the elective list are alternative memberships, not additional course identities.
conditions: University immersion no-program-overlap rule applies.
Closed to advertising and public relations and communication majors.
At least one course at 300 level or above.

routes.title: American Sign Language and Deaf Cultural Studies Immersion
routes.rule_summary: Three courses and nine hours; open to hearing and deaf students, with separate conditions for the ASL-English Interpretation major.
conditions: University immersion no-program-overlap rule applies.
ASLINT-BS students may pursue only the Deaf cultural studies emphasis.
For ASLINT-BS, NASL-180/190/200/210 and MLAS-201/202/301/302/401/402 do not count.
ASLINT-BS immersion courses must differ from the Deaf cultural studies elective counted in that major. These restrictions are not automatically applied to AI-only students.
